justification: Consolidates every value-serving TS reader of dcp_setback_controls onto the ONE guarded implementation - served rows change on live free surfaces (35 flagged-but-numeric rows stop rendering as normal numbers on the assessment DCP tab and duplex-check card; 4 flagged secondary-dwelling rows stop shipping from canibuildit; capacity's arbitrary no-ORDER LIMIT 3 becomes all guarded rows in deterministic order with the zone filter newly applied). Serving-behaviour change on user-facing compliance surfaces = critical tier.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_controls_api.py tests/test_conveyancing_clause_citation.py tests/test_conveyancing_dcp_needs_review.py tests/test_dcp_as_at.py -q && cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest --testPathPatterns="capacity-repoint|parking-rate-selection|dcp-structured-controls" && cd .. && python scripts/check_ts_dcp_readers.py
falsifiable_check.passes_when: The endpoint serves fetch_dcp_setbacks verbatim with three distinguishable states (rows / checked-none-with-reason / 503); the flipped source pins hold (ZERO `FROM dcp_setback_controls` in capacity and parking-rates routes, proxy imports present, universal_residential union in TS, zone passed through); structured-controls can never emit 'under_review' (flagged rows excluded at source); the observation check reports unexpected_inline_readers == [] (baseline met at ship: only the internal review routes + guarded coverage route + test files name the table in executable code).
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Reintroducing inline SQL against dcp_setback_controls in any consolidated route fails its source pin AND appears in check_ts_dcp_readers' unexpected list; serving a needs_review row with a value fails test 'under_review can never be emitted'; collapsing the endpoint's source-failure into an empty success fails test_db_failure_is_503/test_none_result_is_checked_none; dropping the 13-column SELECT extension breaks the three conveyancing fixture suites (they pin the exact column order).
falsifiable_check.demonstrated_failing: The pre-change states are the census (2026-08-03, three claims re-verified in code before design): capacity ran LIMIT 3 with no ORDER BY at :130/:150 (arbitrary rows served); structured-controls' branch order served a flagged row as 'numeric' whenever it had a value (:235-238) - 35 such rows measured live across 13 councils; canibuildit had no needs_review predicate at all (:397-404, 4 flagged SD rows served); three routes weakened is_current to NULL-passes (measured: zero NULL rows exist, so tightening changes nothing); the zone filter existed in NO TS reader. Old-architecture test pins (>=3 inline queries required) were green pre-change and flipped with in-test reasons.
falsifiable_check.mutation_evidence: Make the endpoint return {} on failure -> test_db_failure_is_503 fails. Re-add `FROM dcp_setback_controls` to capacity -> its flipped pin fails and the observation check lists it. Swap the structured-controls branch order back (numeric wins) -> cannot recur: needs_review rows never arrive; the pin asserts statuses never contain under_review from clean rows. Drop registry_pdf_urls from fetch_dcp_setbacks -> the endpoint test's registry map assertion fails. Remove the singleton slug mapper adoption in canibuildit -> keying still tested via lib/lga-slug tests (same six renames verified before the swap).

pre_impl.existing_data: Census of all 18 frontend files naming the table (agent-swept with verbatim snippets; 3 load-bearing claims re-verified by direct read). Blast radius measured live before design: is_current NULL rows = 0; 35 current+needs_review rows (all with numeric values, woollahra-heavy 16) served today by structured-controls; 4 flagged SD rows served by canibuildit; coverage count unchanged 28->28 under the clean predicate. Paid channel (conveyancing) has NO TS readers - it is already Python-side, so 'paid first' resolves to the most-served free surfaces.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: canibuildit's inline slug map carried exactly the six renames lib/lga-slug.ts holds (verified line-by-line before the swap) - keying unchanged. The proxy returns ALL dev_types per LGA; routes filter client-side, which matches how the reference implementation's own consumers (conveyancing renderer) shape its output. Mock fixtures pinning the fetch_dcp_setbacks column order were updated to the 13-column shape in the same change.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: fetch_dcp_setbacks extension is additive (3 SELECT columns, 4 raw row fields, registry_pdf_urls key, savepoint-isolated PDF-map probe) - the paid conveyancing consumers ignore unknown dict keys, and all 3,665 Python tests stay green. Response contracts of the four routes are preserved field-for-field (structured-controls additively gains as_at/as_at_line). Served-row changes are confined to previously-wrong paths and are counted above.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Proxy unreachable -> DcpControlsUnavailableError -> structured-controls returns visible 503; parking-rates records its tier as degraded with a user-facing reason (existing machinery); capacity fails the request as before (500 success:false); canibuildit keeps its non-blocking empty (field unrendered by the UI, census-verified). The endpoint returns 503 on DB failure and available:false with a reason for checked-none - never an empty success.
pre_impl.frontend_type: DcpControlRow/DcpControlsResult typed in lib/dcp-controls-client.ts; route response interfaces unchanged (StructuredControl, ParkingControlRow reused). TSC baseline gate enforces.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A consolidated route that cannot reach the guarded source fails VISIBLY (503/degraded-tier note/500), never with silently emptier data. Users on the assessment DCP tab stop seeing 35 under-review numbers presented as authoritative - visible absence of quarantined values is the fix working.

functions.name: dcp_controls
functions.input: lga slug + optional zone string, as query params from the TS client
functions.output: the guarded fetch_dcp_setbacks result flattened to rows + as-at + registry PDF map, or available:false with reason, or HTTP 503
functions.if_none: fetch returning None -> available:false with the honest dual-cause reason (no rows OR swallowed failure - a documented limitation of the shared implementation)

functions.name: fetchDcpControls
functions.input: lga slug + optional zone, from the four consolidated routes
functions.output: typed DcpControlsResult from PYTHON_API_URL/pipeline/dcp-controls with a 20s abort
functions.if_none: network/non-OK -> DcpControlsUnavailableError so every caller converts to ITS visible degraded shape - never an empty success

functions.name: fetch_dcp_setbacks
functions.input: connection + lga slug + optional zone code (unchanged signature)
functions.output: existing dict + additive raw citation fields per row + registry_pdf_urls map (savepoint-isolated probe)
functions.if_none: unchanged: None on no rows or swallowed failure; PDF-map probe failure degrades to an empty map without poisoning the transaction

values.value: proxy rows in each consolidated route
values.if_missing: empty slices -> the route's existing empty-state responses; unavailability throws to the route's visible failure path

values.guard_at: frontend-nextjs/app/api/dcp/structured-controls/route.ts:200-207 (null coalescing; anchor only when pdf_page present)
values.if_missing: pdf_url null - the UI renders the citation without a link, as before

queries.purpose: the ONE guarded controls read (now also the proxy's source)
queries.where_clause: lga = %s AND is_current = TRUE AND (needs_review IS NULL OR needs_review = FALSE), deterministic ORDER BY with id tiebreak
queries.if_wrong: per-row needs_review re-check + zone_specific condition filter remain; fixtures pin the column order

queries.purpose: coverage metadata read (kept direct by design, guards adopted)
queries.where_clause: c.is_current = TRUE AND (c.needs_review IS NULL OR c.needs_review = FALSE) + registry scoping
queries.if_zero: empty council list renders as before
queries.if_wrong: measured before shipping: clean predicate changes the count 28 -> 28

queries.purpose: registry PDF-URL map for citation links
queries.where_clause: council = %s AND is_active = TRUE AND r2_public_pdf_url IS NOT NULL
queries.if_zero: empty map - citations render without links
queries.if_wrong: per-council parameter makes cross-council contamination structurally impossible (the old TS JOIN needed a leak sentinel; the map does not)

break_it.scenario: a needs_review row with a numeric value reaches the assessment DCP tab or duplex-check card
break_it.what_happens: pre-change: served as a normal authoritative number (numeric won the branch) - 35 live rows measured; the quarantine was decorative
break_it.how: rows now come from fetch_dcp_setbacks which excludes flagged rows in SQL AND per-row; the route cannot emit under_review from clean rows (pinned)

break_it.scenario: capacity serves an arbitrary 3 of N parking rows that changes between deploys
break_it.what_happens: pre-change: LIMIT 3 with no ORDER BY - which rows a user saw was up to the planner
break_it.how: all guarded rows in the source's deterministic order (value/section/id tiebreaks added at scripts/conveyancing_db.py:298-299); the flipped pin forbids inline SQL returning

break_it.scenario: the Python backend is down while a user opens the assessment DCP tab
break_it.what_happens: risk introduced by proxying: a new failure mode where the old code hit the DB directly
break_it.how: visible 503 with a retry message (never empty success); parking-rates degrades tier-by-tier with user-facing reasons; capacity fails the request visibly; the trade-off (one guard implementation over one fewer hop) is the item-5 doctrine, stated in the PR

break_it.scenario: the slug-mapper swap silently changes how canibuildit keys its council lookups
break_it.what_happens: a council's rows would vanish or belong to the wrong LGA on the granny-flat tool
break_it.how: the inline map's six renames were verified identical to lib/lga-slug.ts line-by-line BEFORE the swap; toLgaSlug additionally null-guards empty input (the inline version could query lga = '')

break_it.scenario: the fetch_dcp_setbacks SELECT extension breaks the paid conveyancing path
break_it.what_happens: the 13-column unpack or new dict keys could disturb the PDF/brief consumers
break_it.how: additive keys only; all three fixture suites updated to the exact column order and the full 3,665-test Python suite green incl. conveyancing forensic/citation/needs-review suites

break_it.scenario: the PDF-map probe fails mid-transaction and takes the as-at probe down with it
break_it.what_happens: a poisoned transaction would degrade every subsequent read in the shared function
break_it.how: scripts/conveyancing_db.py:318-338 - savepoint-isolated like the as-at probe (the item-3 Sol doctrine applied to the new query)
break_it.repro: mock-cursor suites exercise the probe failure path; fetch returns rows with an empty map

break_it.scenario: the observation check goes green while an inline reader hides in a comment-stripped edge
break_it.what_happens: a false all-clear on the consolidation invariant while an inline reader still executes
break_it.how: the check strips comments (matching what files EXECUTE) and fails with exit 2 when it cannot find even the internal-review routes (a scan that finds nothing is a broken scan, DQ-30 lesson)

break_it.scenario: the registry PDF-URL map probe fails and citation links silently vanish or mislink
break_it.what_happens: controls would render without their page-anchored citation links, or a poisoned transaction would degrade every later read in the shared function
break_it.how: scripts/conveyancing_db.py:318-338 savepoint isolation (empty map on failure, transaction intact); the map is per-council by parameter so a mislink to another council's PDF is structurally impossible
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_dcp_controls_api.py (registry map assertion) + the mock-cursor suites exercising probe failure

post_merge.manual_verify: Railway deploys the new /pipeline/dcp-controls endpoint on merge (auto-deploy from GitHub); the four routes depend on it, so merge backend and frontend together (single squash does this).
